title: One row of a leaderboard release: results.parquet
description: One score for one tool, setting, relative, stratum and metric, with the cost of the run that produced it. Follows section 6 of docs/annotation_leaderboard_research.md in seanome/2024-kmerseek-analysis (PR 147). Checked by scripts/validate_rows.py. A row run by the host from a submitted module must fill every column marked submitted_required; rows carried over from runs made before the submission path existed may leave those empty, and the validator counts the empty cells per column.

columns.name: experiment
columns.description: Benchmark the row belongs to, e.g. qfo_region_midi_plus.

columns.name: query_set
columns.description: Which queries were searched.

columns.name: tool
columns.description: Tool id, as in the module name and claims/<tool>.yaml.

columns.name: tool_version
columns.description: Version the tool prints, as run.

columns.name: setting
columns.description: Named set of parameters, e.g. s7 for MMseqs2 -s 7.

columns.name: container_digest
columns.description: Image the host ran, pinned by digest: <registry>/<image>@sha256:<64 hex>.

columns.name: dataset_version
columns.description: Version of the truth set, when the source table records one.

columns.name: target_db
columns.description: Database searched: a relative's proteome, or a library such as Pfam-A HMMs.

columns.name: truth_source
columns.description: Truth the calls are scored against.

columns.name: dedup_or_raw
columns.description: Calls as the tool made them (raw) or after overlapping calls are merged (dedup).

columns.name: stratum_key
columns.description: What the rows are split by: all, identity, plddt, feature_type, feature_length_bin.

columns.name: stratum_value
columns.description: Which part of the split, e.g. 20-30%; all when stratum_key is all.

columns.name: metric
columns.description: Metric id, e.g. fmax. Defined on the site's How the scores work page.

columns.name: value
columns.description: The score.

columns.name: ci95_low
columns.description: Lower end of the 95% interval of value.

columns.name: ci95_high
columns.description: Upper end of the 95% interval of value.

columns.name: n
columns.description: Truth instances behind value. A page shows a row with n under 30 in grey.

columns.name: cpu_h_per_1000
columns.description: Measured: reserved core-hours (cores x wall time from the Nextflow trace) for the search step against one relative, per 1,000 queries.

columns.name: peak_rss_gb
columns.description: Measured: largest peak_rss of any search task in the trace, GB.

columns.name: gpu_h_per_1000
columns.description: Measured: GPU-hours per relative per 1,000 queries; 0 for a CPU-only tool.

columns.name: usd_per_1000_from_rate
columns.description: Not measured: cpu_h_per_1000 x usd_rate_cpu_h + gpu_h_per_1000 x usd_rate_gpu_h, from a price list.

columns.name: usd_rate_cpu_h
columns.description: Dollars per core-hour used for usd_per_1000_from_rate.

columns.name: usd_rate_gpu_h
columns.description: Dollars per GPU-hour used for usd_per_1000_from_rate.

columns.name: usd_rate_source
columns.description: Where the two rates come from, with the date they were read.

columns.name: hardware
columns.description: Machine the host ran it on, e.g. Stanford Sherlock, SLURM partition hns.

columns.name: run_date
columns.description: Date the host's run finished, YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: source_commit
columns.description: Commit of seanome/2024-kmerseek-analysis whose pipeline produced the row.
